name: The Whole Armor Of God
overview: The Scriptures call believers to be spiritually equipped by putting on the whole armor of God to stand firm against the devil’s schemes, recognizing that our struggle is not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of darkness (Ephesians 6:11-12). This armor includes righteousness as a breastplate and salvation as a helmet, reflecting the protective garments God Himself wears (Isaiah 59:17). Strength and victory come through reliance on the Lord's power, and knowing the truth brings freedom, enabling believers to stand firm in faith (Ephesians 6:10; John 8:32).
